title: Configuring a User Portal Acceptable Use Policy

blocks.text: You can create an acceptable use policy (AUP) that your users must accept before they connect to a user portal and a Privileged Remote Access (PRA) Portal. AUPs provide visibility to authorized applications for your organization's employees and partners.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Clientless Portal > Portal Acceptable Use Policy.
On the Acceptable Use Policy page:
Frequency: Select how often the user portal and PRA Portal display the AUP (i.e., Once or Never).
Display Text: Enter or copy and paste your organization's AUP into the field.
Email: Enter the email address for your organization's support team.
Phone Number: Enter the phone number for your organization's support team.
(Optional) Click Preview to view the AUP that users will see when they initially access a user portal and PRA Portal.
